text_en: In the third year of the reign of Joakim, king of Juda , Nabuchodonosor, king of Babylon , came to Jerusalem , and besieged it.
text_la: Anno tertio regni Joakim regis Juda, venit Nabuchodonosor, rex Babylonis, in Jerusalem, et obsedit eam:
text_pt: No ano terceiro do reinado de Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, veio Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, a Jerusalém, e a sitiou.
text_el: ἐν ἔτει τρίτῳ τῆς βασιλείας Ιωακιμ βασιλέως Ιουδα ἦλθεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπολιόρκει αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord delivered into his hands Joakim, the king of Juda , and part of the vessels of the house of God : and he carried them away into the land of Sennaar, to the house of his god, and the vessels he brought into the treasure house of his god.
text_la: et tradidit Dominus in manu ejus Joakim, regem Juda, et partem vasorum domus Dei : et asportavit ea in terram Sennaar in domum dei sui, et vasa intulit in domum thesauri dei sui.
text_pt: E o Senhor entregou nas suas mãos a Jeoiaquim, rei de Judá, e uma parte dos utensílios da casa de Deus, e ele os levou para a terra de Sinar, para a casa do seu deus, e pôs os utensílios na casa do tesouro do seu deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν Ιωακιμ βασιλέα Ιουδα καὶ ἀπὸ μέρους τῶν σκευῶν οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἤνεγκεν αὐτὰ εἰς γῆν Σεννααρ οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ σκεύη εἰσήνεγκεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον θησαυροῦ τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the king spoke to Asphenez, the master of the eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel , and of the king's seed, and of the princes,
text_la: Et ait rex Asphenez præposito eunuchorum ut introduceret de filiis Israël, et de semine regio et tyrannorum,
text_pt: E disse o rei a Aspenaz, chefe dos seus eunucos, que trouxesse alguns dos filhos de Israel, e da linhagem real e dos príncipes,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Ασφανεζ τῷ ἀρχιευνούχῳ αὐτοῦ εἰσαγαγεῖν ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ σπέρματος τῆς βασιλείας καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν φορθομμιν

text_en: children in whom there was no blemish, well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, acute in knowledge , and instructed in science, and such as might stand in the king's palace, that he might teach them the learning, and the tongue of the Chaldeans .
text_la: pueros in quibus nulla esset macula, decoros forma, et eruditos omni sapientia, cautos scientia, et doctos disciplina, et qui possent stare in palatio regis, ut doceret eos litteras et linguam Chaldæorum.
text_pt: Jovens em quem não houvesse defeito algum, de boa aparência, e instruídos em toda a sabedoria, e doutos em ciência, e entendidos no conhecimento, e que tivessem habilidade para assistirem no palácio do rei, e que lhes ensinassem as letras e a língua dos caldeus.
text_el: νεανίσκους οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς μῶμος καὶ καλοὺς τῇ ὄψει καὶ συνιέντας ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ γιγνώσκοντας γνῶσιν καὶ διανοουμένους φρόνησιν καὶ οἷς ἐστιν ἰσχὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς ἑστάναι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ διδάξαι αὐτοὺς γράμματα καὶ γλῶσσαν Χαλδαίων

text_en: And the king appointed them a daily provision, of his own meat, and of the wine of which he drank himself, that being nourished three years, afterwards they might stand before the king.
text_la: Et constituit eis rex annonam per singulos dies de cibis suis, et de vino unde bibebat ipse, ut enutriti tribus annis, postea starent in conspectu regis.
text_pt: E o rei lhes determinou a porção diária, das iguarias do rei, e do vinho que ele bebia, e que assim fossem mantidos por três anos, para que no fim destes pudessem estar diante do rei.
text_el: καὶ διέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸ τῆς ἡμέρας καθ' ἡμέραν ἀπὸ τῆς τραπέζης τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ πότου αὐτοῦ καὶ θρέψαι αὐτοὺς ἔτη τρία καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα στῆναι ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: Now there was among them of the children of Juda , Daniel , Ananias, Misael, and Azarias.
text_la: Fuerunt ergo inter eos de filiis Juda, Daniel, Ananias, Misaël, et Azarias.
text_pt: E entre eles se achavam, dos filhos de Judá, Daniel, Hananias, Misael e Azarias;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ιουδα Δανιηλ καὶ Ανανιας καὶ Μισαηλ καὶ Αζαριας

text_en: And the master of the eunuchs gave them names : to Daniel , Baltassar: to Ananias, Sidrach: to Misael, Misach: and to Azarias, Abdenago.
text_la: Et imposuit eis præpositus eunuchorum nomina : Danieli, Baltassar; Ananiæ, Sidrach; Misaëli, Misach; et Azariæ, Abdenago.
text_pt: E o chefe dos eunucos lhes pôs outros nomes, a saber: a Daniel pôs o de Beltessazar, e a Hananias o de Sadraque, e a Misael o de Mesaque, e a Azarias o de Abednego.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἀρχιευνοῦχος ὀνόματα τῷ Δανιηλ Βαλτασαρ καὶ τῷ Ανανια Σεδραχ καὶ τῷ Μισαηλ Μισαχ καὶ τῷ Αζαρια Αβδεναγω

text_en: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not be defiled with the king's table, nor with the wine which he drank: and he requested the master of the eunuchs that he might not be defiled.
text_la: Proposuit autem Daniel in corde suo ne pollueretur de mensa regis, neque de vino potus ejus : et rogavit eunuchorum præpositum ne contaminaretur.
text_pt: E Daniel propôs no seu coração não se contaminar com a porção das iguarias do rei, nem com o vinho que ele bebia; portanto pediu ao chefe dos eunucos que lhe permitisse não se contaminar.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο Δανιηλ ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ὡς οὐ μὴ ἀλισγηθῇ ἐν τῇ τραπέζῃ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴνῳ τοῦ πότου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἠξίωσε τὸν ἀρχιευνοῦχον ὡς οὐ μὴ ἀλισγηθῇ

text_en: And God gave to Daniel grace and mercy in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
text_la: Dedit autem Deus Danieli gratiam et misericordiam in conspectu principis eunuchorum.
text_pt: Ora, Deus fez com que Daniel achasse graça e misericórdia diante do chefe dos eunucos.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν Δανιηλ εἰς ἔλεον καὶ εἰς οἰκτιρμὸν ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀρχιευνούχου

text_en: And the prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel : I fear my lord, the king, who has appointed you meat and drink: who if he should see your faces leaner than those of the other youths, your equals, you shall endanger my head to the king.
text_la: Et ait princeps eunuchorum ad Danielem : Timeo ego dominum meum regem, qui constituit vobis cibum et potum : qui si viderit vultus vestros macilentiores præ ceteris adolescentibus coævis vestris, condemnabitis caput meum regi.
text_pt: E disse o chefe dos eunucos a Daniel: Tenho medo do meu senhor, o rei, que determinou a vossa comida e a vossa bebida; pois por que veria ele os vossos rostos mais tristes do que os dos outros jovens da vossa idade? Assim porias em perigo a minha cabeça para com o rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἀρχιευνοῦχος τῷ Δανιηλ φοβοῦμαι ἐγὼ τὸν κύριόν μου τὸν βασιλέα τὸν ἐκτάξαντα τὴν βρῶσιν ὑμῶν καὶ τὴν πόσιν ὑμῶν μήποτε ἴδῃ τὰ πρόσωπα ὑμῶν σκυθρωπὰ παρὰ τὰ παιδάρια τὰ συνήλικα ὑμῶν καὶ καταδικάσητε τὴν κεφαλήν μου τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: And Daniel said to Malasar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel , Ananias, Misael, and Azarias:
text_la: Et dixit Daniel ad Malasar, quem constituerat princeps eunuchorum super Danielem, Ananiam, Misaëlem, et Azariam:
text_pt: Então disse Daniel ao despenseiro a quem o chefe dos eunucos havia constituído sobre Daniel, Hananias, Misael e Azarias:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δανιηλ πρὸς Αμελσαδ ὃν κατέστησεν ὁ ἀρχιευνοῦχος ἐπὶ Δανιηλ Ανανιαν Μισαηλ Αζαριαν

text_en: Try, I beseech you, your servants for ten days, and let pulse be given us to eat, and water to drink:
text_la: Tenta nos, obsecro, servos tuos, diebus decem, et dentur nobis legumina ad vescendum, et aqua ad bibendum:
text_pt: Experimenta, peço-te, os teus servos dez dias, e que se nos dêem legumes a comer, e água a beber.
text_el: πείρασον δὴ τοὺς παῖδάς σου ἡμέρας δέκα καὶ δότωσαν ἡμῖν ἀπὸ τῶν σπερμάτων καὶ φαγόμεθα καὶ ὕδωρ πιόμεθα

text_en: And look upon our faces, and the faces of the children that eat of the king's meat: and as you shall see, deal with your servants.
text_la: et contemplare vultus nostros, et vultus puerorum, qui vescuntur cibo regio : et sicut videris, facies cum servis tuis.
text_pt: Então se examine diante de ti a nossa aparência, e a aparência dos jovens que comem a porção das iguarias do rei; e, conforme vires, procederás para com os teus servos.
text_el: καὶ ὀφθήτωσαν ἐνώπιόν σου αἱ ἰδέαι ἡμῶν καὶ αἱ ἰδέαι τῶν παιδαρίων τῶν ἐσθιόντων τὴν τράπεζαν τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ καθὼς ἂν ἴδῃς ποίησον μετὰ τῶν παίδων σου

text_en: And when he had heard these words, he tried them for ten days.
text_la: Qui, audito sermone hujuscemodi, tentavit eos diebus decem.
text_pt: E ele consentiu isto, e os experimentou dez dias.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπείρασεν αὐτοὺς ἡμέρας δέκα

text_en: And after ten days, their faces appeared fairer and fatter than all the children that ate of the king's meat.
text_la: Post dies autem decem, apparuerunt vultus eorum meliores, et corpulentiores præ omnibus pueris, qui vescebantur cibo regio.
text_pt: E, ao fim dos dez dias, apareceram os seus semblantes melhores, e eles estavam mais gordos de carne do que todos os jovens que comiam das iguarias do rei.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῶν δέκα ἡμερῶν ὡράθησαν αἱ ἰδέαι αὐτῶν ἀγαθαὶ καὶ ἰσχυραὶ ταῖς σαρξὶν ὑπὲρ τὰ παιδάρια τὰ ἐσθίοντα τὴν τράπεζαν τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: So Malasar took their portions, and the wine that they should drink: and he gave them pulse.
text_la: Porro Malasar tollebat cibaria, et vinum potus eorum : dabatque eis legumina.
text_pt: Assim o despenseiro tirou-lhes a porção das iguarias, e o vinho de que deviam beber, e lhes dava legumes.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο Αμελσαδ ἀναιρούμενος τὸ δεῖπνον αὐτῶν καὶ τὸν οἶνον τοῦ πόματος αὐτῶν καὶ ἐδίδου αὐτοῖς σπέρματα

text_en: And to these children God gave knowledge , and understanding in every book, and wisdom: but to Daniel the understanding also of all visions and dreams .
text_la: Pueris autem his dedit Deus scientiam et disciplinam, in omni libro et sapientia : Danieli autem intelligentiam omnium visionum et somniorum.
text_pt: Quanto a estes quatro jovens, Deus lhes deu o conhecimento e a inteligência em todas as letras, e sabedoria; mas a Daniel deu entendimento em toda a visão e sonhos.
text_el: καὶ τὰ παιδάρια ταῦτα οἱ τέσσαρες αὐτοί ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς σύνεσιν καὶ φρόνησιν ἐν πάσῃ γραμματικῇ καὶ σοφίᾳ καὶ Δανιηλ συνῆκεν ἐν πάσῃ ὁράσει καὶ ἐνυπνίοις

text_en: And when the days were ended, after which the king had ordered they should be brought in: the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nabuchodonosor .
text_la: Completis itaque diebus, post quos dixerat rex ut introducerentur, introduxit eos præpositus eunuchorum in conspectu Nabuchodonosor.
text_pt: E ao fim dos dias, em que o rei tinha falado que os trouxessem, o chefe dos eunucos os trouxe diante de Nabucodonosor.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῶν ἡμερῶν ὧν εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰσαγαγεῖν αὐτούς καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ὁ ἀρχιευνοῦχος ἐναντίον Ναβουχοδονοσορ

text_en: And when the king had spoken to them, there were not found among them all such as Daniel , Ananias, Misael, and Azarias: and they stood in the king's presence.
text_la: Cumque eis locutus fuisset rex, non sunt inventi tales de universis, ut Daniel, Ananias, Misaël, et Azarias : et steterunt in conspectu regis.
text_pt: E o rei falou com eles; entre todos eles não foram achados outros tais como Daniel, Hananias, Misael e Azarias; portanto ficaram assistindo diante do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετ' αὐτῶν ὁ βασιλεύς καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθησαν ἐκ πάντων αὐτῶν ὅμοιοι Δανιηλ καὶ Ανανια καὶ Μισαηλ καὶ Αζαρια καὶ ἔστησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the diviners , and wise men, that were in all his kingdom.
text_la: Et omne verbum sapientiæ et intellectus, quod sciscitatus est ab eis rex, invenit in eis decuplum super cunctos ariolos et magos qui erant in universo regno ejus.
text_pt: E em toda a matéria de sabedoria e de discernimento, sobre o que o rei lhes perguntou, os achou dez vezes mais doutos do que todos os magos astrólogos que havia em todo o seu reino.
text_el: καὶ ἐν παντὶ ῥήματι σοφίας καὶ ἐπιστήμης ὧν ἐζήτησεν παρ' αὐτῶν ὁ βασιλεύς εὗρεν αὐτοὺς δεκαπλασίονας παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἐπαοιδοὺς καὶ τοὺς μάγους τοὺς ὄντας ἐν πάσῃ τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus.
text_la: Fuit autem Daniel usque ad annum primum Cyri regis.
text_pt: E Daniel permaneceu até ao primeiro ano do rei Ciro.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο Δανιηλ ἕως ἔτους ἑνὸς Κύρου τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: In the second year of the reign of Nabuchodonosor , Nabuchodonosor had a dream, and his spirit was terrified , and his dream went out of his mind .
text_la: In anno secundo regni Nabuchodonosor, vidit Nabuchodonosor somnium, et conterritus est spiritus ejus, et somnium ejus fugit ab eo.
text_pt: E no segundo ano do reinado de Nabucodonosor, Nabucodonosor teve sonhos; e o seu espírito se perturbou, e passou-se-lhe o sono.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δευτέρῳ τῆς βασιλείας Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἠνυπνιάσθη Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἐνύπνιον καὶ ἐξέστη τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ ὕπνος αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then the king commanded to call together the diviners and the wise men , and the magicians, and the Chaldeans: to declare to the king his dreams: so they came and stood before the king.
text_la: Præcepit autem rex ut convocarentur arioli, et magi, et malefici, et Chaldæi, ut indicarent regi somnia sua. Qui cum venissent, steterunt coram rege.
text_pt: Então o rei mandou chamar os magos, os astrólogos, os encantadores e os caldeus, para que declarassem ao rei os seus sonhos; e eles vieram e se apresentaram diante do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καλέσαι τοὺς ἐπαοιδοὺς καὶ τοὺς μάγους καὶ τοὺς φαρμακοὺς καὶ τοὺς Χαλδαίους τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι τῷ βασιλεῖ τὰ ἐνύπνια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθαν καὶ ἔστησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And the king said to them: I saw a dream: and being troubled in mind I know not what I saw.
text_la: Et dixit ad eos rex : Vidi somnium, et mente confusus ignoro quid viderim.
text_pt: E o rei lhes disse: Tive um sonho; e para saber o sonho está perturbado o meu espírito.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεύς ἠνυπνιάσθην καὶ ἐξέστη τὸ πνεῦμά μου τοῦ γνῶναι τὸ ἐνύπνιον

text_en: And the Chaldeans answered the king in Syriac : O king, live for ever: tell to your servants your dream, and we will declare the interpretation thereof.
text_la: Responderuntque Chaldæi regi syriace : Rex, in sempiternum vive! dic somnium servis tuis, et interpretationem ejus indicabimus.
text_pt: E os caldeus disseram ao rei em aramaico: Ó rei, vive eternamente! Dize o sonho a teus servos, e daremos a interpretação.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησαν οἱ Χαλδαῖοι τῷ βασιλεῖ Συριστί βασιλεῦ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ζῆθι σὺ εἰπὸν τὸ ἐνύπνιον τοῖς παισίν σου καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν ἀναγγελοῦμεν

text_en: And the king, answering, said to the Chaldeans: The thing has gone out of my mind : unless you tell me the dream, and the meaning thereof, you shall be put to death , and your houses shall be confiscated.
text_la: Et respondens rex ait Chaldæis : Sermo recessit a me : nisi indicaveritis mihi somnium, et conjecturam ejus, peribitis vos, et domus vestræ publicabuntur.
text_pt: Respondeu o rei, e disse aos caldeus: O assunto me tem escapado; se não me fizerdes saber o sonho e a sua interpretação, sereis despedaçados, e as vossas casas serão feitas um monturo;
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς Χαλδαίοις ὁ λόγος ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἀπέστη ἐὰν μὴ γνωρίσητέ μοι τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ἔσεσθε καὶ οἱ οἶκοι ὑμῶν διαρπαγήσονται

text_en: But if you tell the dream, and the meaning of it, you shall receive of me rewards, and gifts, and great honour : therefore, tell me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
text_la: Si autem somnium, et conjecturam ejus narraveritis, præmia, et dona, et honorem multum accipietis a me. Somnium igitur, et interpretationem ejus indicate mihi.
text_pt: Mas se vós me declarardes o sonho e a sua interpretação, recebereis de mim dádivas, recompensas e grande honra; portanto declarai-me o sonho e a sua interpretação.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ γνωρίσητέ μοι δόματα καὶ δωρεὰς καὶ τιμὴν πολλὴν λήμψεσθε παρ' ἐμοῦ πλὴν τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι

text_en: They answered again and said: Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will declare the interpretation of it.
text_la: Responderunt secundo, atque dixerunt : Rex somnium dicat servis suis, et interpretationem illius indicabimus.
text_pt: Responderam segunda vez, e disseram: Diga o rei o sonho a seus servos, e daremos a sua interpretação.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν δεύτερον καὶ εἶπαν ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰπάτω τὸ ἐνύπνιον τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ ἀναγγελοῦμεν

text_en: The king answered and said: I know for certain , that you seek to gain time , since you know that the thing has gone from me.
text_la: Respondit rex, et ait : Certe novi quod tempus redimitis, scientes quod recesserit a me sermo.
text_pt: Respondeu o rei, e disse: Percebo muito bem que vós quereis ganhar tempo; porque vedes que o assunto me tem escapado.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ εἶπεν ἐπ' ἀληθείας οἶδα ἐγὼ ὅτι καιρὸν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε καθότι εἴδετε ὅτι ἀπέστη ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὸ ῥῆμα

text_en: If, therefore, you tell me not the dream, there is one sentence concerning you, that you have also framed a lying interpretation , and full of deceit , to speak before me till the time pass away. Tell me, therefore, the dream, that I may know that you also give a true interpretation thereof.
text_la: Si ergo somnium non indicaveritis mihi, una est de vobis sententia, quod interpretationem quoque fallacem, et deceptione plenam composueritis, ut loquamini mihi donec tempus pertranseat. Somnium itaque dicite mihi, ut sciam quod interpretationem quoque ejus veram loquamini.
text_pt: De modo que, se não me fizerdes saber o sonho, uma só sentença será a vossa; pois vós preparastes palavras mentirosas e perversas para as proferirdes na minha presença, até que se mude o tempo; portanto dizei-me o sonho, para que eu entenda que me podeis dar a sua interpretação.
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν τὸ ἐνύπνιον μὴ ἀναγγείλητέ μοι οἶδα ὅτι ῥῆμα ψευδὲς καὶ διεφθαρμένον συνέθεσθε εἰπεῖν ἐνώπιόν μου ἕως οὗ ὁ καιρὸς παρέλθῃ τὸ ἐνύπνιόν μου εἴπατέ μοι καὶ γνώσομαι ὅτι τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ ἀναγγελεῖτέ μοι

text_en: Then the Chaldeans answered before the king, and said: There is no man upon earth, that can accomplish your word, O king; neither does any king, though great and mighty, ask such a thing of any diviner , or wise man, or Chaldean.
text_la: Respondentes ergo Chaldæi coram rege, dixerunt : Non est homo super terram, qui sermonem tuum, rex, possit implere : sed neque regum quisquam magnus et potens verbum hujuscemodi sciscitatur ab omni ariolo, et mago, et Chaldæo.
text_pt: Responderam os caldeus na presença do rei, e disseram: Não há ninguém sobre a terra que possa declarar a palavra ao rei; pois nenhum rei há, grande ou dominador, que requeira coisas semelhantes de algum mago, ou astrólogo, ou caldeu.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Χαλδαῖοι ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ λέγουσιν οὐκ ἔστιν ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τῆς ξηρᾶς ὅστις τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦ βασιλέως δυνήσεται γνωρίσαι καθότι πᾶς βασιλεὺς μέγας καὶ ἄρχων ῥῆμα τοιοῦτο οὐκ ἐπερωτᾷ ἐπαοιδόν μάγον καὶ Χαλδαῖον

text_en: For the thing that you ask, O king, is difficult: nor can any one be found that can show it before the king, except the gods, whose conversation is not with men .
text_la: Sermo enim, quem tu quæris, rex, gravis est : nec reperietur quisquam qui indicet illum in conspectu regis, exceptis diis, quorum non est cum hominibus conversatio.
text_pt: Porque o assunto que o rei requer é difícil; e ninguém há que o possa declarar diante do rei, senão os deuses, cuja morada não é com a carne.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ λόγος ὃν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐπερωτᾷ βαρύς καὶ ἕτερος οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἀναγγελεῖ αὐτὸν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως ἀλλ' ἢ θεοί ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ κατοικία μετὰ πάσης σαρκός

text_en: Upon hearing this, the king in fury , and in great wrath , commanded that all the wise men of Babylon should be put to death .
text_la: Quo audito, rex, in furore et in ira magna, præcepit ut perirent omnes sapientes Babylonis.
text_pt: Por isso o rei muito se irou e enfureceu; e ordenou que matassem a todos os sábios de babilônia.
text_el: τότε ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν θυμῷ καὶ ὀργῇ πολλῇ εἶπεν ἀπολέσαι πάντας τοὺς σοφοὺς Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And the decree being gone forth, the wise men were slain : and Daniel and his companions were sought for, to be put to death .
text_la: Et egressa sententia, sapientes interficiebantur : quærebanturque Daniel et socii ejus, ut perirent.
text_pt: E saiu o decreto, segundo o qual deviam ser mortos os sábios; e buscaram a Daniel e aos seus companheiros, para que fossem mortos.
text_el: καὶ τὸ δόγμα ἐξῆλθεν καὶ οἱ σοφοὶ ἀπεκτέννοντο καὶ ἐζήτησαν Δανιηλ καὶ τοὺς φίλους αὐτοῦ ἀνελεῖν

text_en: Then Daniel inquired concerning the law and the sentence, of Arioch, the general of the king's army, who had gone forth to kill the wise men of Babylon .
text_la: Tunc Daniel requisivit de lege atque sententia ab Arioch principe militiæ regis, qui egressus fuerat ad interficiendos sapientes Babylonis.
text_pt: Então Daniel falou avisada e prudentemente a Arioque, capitão da guarda do rei, que tinha saído para matar os sábios de babilônia.
text_el: τότε Δανιηλ ἀπεκρίθη βουλὴν καὶ γνώμην τῷ Αριωχ τῷ ἀρχιμαγείρῳ τοῦ βασιλέως ὃς ἐξῆλθεν ἀναιρεῖν τοὺς σοφοὺς Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And he asked him that had received the orders of the king, why so cruel a sentence had gone forth from the face of the king. And when Arioch had told the matter to Daniel ,
text_la: Et interrogavit eum, qui a rege potestatem acceperat, quam ob causam tam crudelis sententia a facie regis esset egressa. Cum ergo rem indicasset Arioch Danieli,
text_pt: Respondeu, e disse a Arioque, capitão do rei: Por que se apressa tanto o decreto da parte do rei? Então Arioque explicou o caso a Daniel.
text_el: ἄρχων τοῦ βασιλέως περὶ τίνος ἐξῆλθεν ἡ γνώμη ἡ ἀναιδὴς ἐκ προσώπου τοῦ βασιλέως ἐγνώρισεν δὲ τὸ ῥῆμα Αριωχ τῷ Δανιηλ

text_en: Daniel went in, and desired of the king, that he would give him time to resolve the question, and declare it to the king.
text_la: Daniel ingressus rogavit regem ut tempus daret sibi ad solutionem indicandam regi.
text_pt: E Daniel entrou; e pediu ao rei que lhe desse tempo, para que lhe pudesse dar a interpretação.
text_el: καὶ Δανιηλ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἠξίωσεν τὸν βασιλέα ὅπως χρόνον δῷ αὐτῷ καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ ἀναγγείλῃ τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: And he went into his house, and told the matter to Ananias, and Misael, and Azarias, his companions:
text_la: Et ingressus est domum suam, Ananiæque et Misaëli et Azariæ, sociis suis, indicavit negotium,
text_pt: Então Daniel foi para a sua casa, e fez saber o caso a Hananias, Misael e Azarias, seus companheiros;
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Δανιηλ εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ Ανανια καὶ τῷ Μισαηλ καὶ τῷ Αζαρια τοῖς φίλοις αὐτοῦ τὸ ῥῆμα ἐγνώρισεν

text_en: To the end that they should ask mercy at the face of the God of heaven , concerning this secret, and that Daniel and his companions might not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon .
text_la: ut quærerent misericordiam a facie Dei cæli super sacramento isto, et non perirent Daniel et socii ejus cum ceteris sapientibus Babylonis.
text_pt: Para que pedissem misericórdia ao Deus do céu, sobre este mistério, a fim de que Daniel e seus companheiros não perecessem, juntamente com o restante dos sábios da Babilônia.
text_el: καὶ οἰκτιρμοὺς ἐζήτουν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὑπὲρ τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου ὅπως ἂν μὴ ἀπόλωνται Δανιηλ καὶ οἱ φίλοι αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἐπιλοίπων σοφῶν Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: Then was the mystery revealed to Daniel by a vision in the night: and Daniel blessed the God of heaven ,
text_la: Tunc Danieli mysterium per visionem nocte revelatum est : et benedixit Daniel Deum cæli,
text_pt: Então foi revelado o mistério a Daniel numa visão de noite; então Daniel louvou o Deus do céu.
text_el: τότε τῷ Δανιηλ ἐν ὁράματι τῆς νυκτὸς τὸ μυστήριον ἀπεκαλύφθη καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: and speaking, he said: Blessed be the name of the Lord from eternity and for evermore: for wisdom and fortitude are his.
text_la: et locutus ait : Sit nomen Domini benedictum a sæculo et usque in sæculum : quia sapientia et fortitudo ejus sunt.
text_pt: Falou Daniel, dizendo: Seja bendito o nome de Deus de eternidade a eternidade, porque dele são a sabedoria e a força;
text_el: Δανιηλ καὶ εἶπεν εἴη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ εὐλογημένον ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ὅτι ἡ σοφία καὶ ἡ σύνεσις αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: And he changes times and ages: takes away kingdoms, and establishes them: gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to them that have understanding:
text_la: Et ipse mutat tempora, et ætates : transfert regna, atque constituit : dat sapientiam sapientibus, et scientiam intelligentibus disciplinam.
text_pt: E ele muda os tempos e as estações; ele remove os reis e estabelece os reis; ele dá sabedoria aos sábios e conhecimento aos entendidos.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἀλλοιοῖ καιροὺς καὶ χρόνους καθιστᾷ βασιλεῖς καὶ μεθιστᾷ διδοὺς σοφίαν τοῖς σοφοῖς καὶ φρόνησιν τοῖς εἰδόσιν σύνεσιν

text_en: He reveals deep and hidden things, and knows what is in darkness: and light is with him.
text_la: Ipse revelat profunda et abscondita, et novit in tenebris constituta : et lux cum eo est.
text_pt: Ele revela o profundo e o escondido; conhece o que está em trevas, e com ele mora a luz.
text_el: αὐτὸς ἀποκαλύπτει βαθέα καὶ ἀπόκρυφα γινώσκων τὰ ἐν τῷ σκότει καὶ τὸ φῶς μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: To you, O God of our fathers, I give thanks, and I praise you: because you have given me wisdom and strength: and now you have shown me what we desired of you, for you have made known to us the king's discourse.
text_la: Tibi, Deus patrum nostrorum, confiteor, teque laudo, quia sapientiam et fortitudinem dedisti mihi, et nunc ostendisti mihi quæ rogavimus te, quia sermonem regis aperuisti nobis.
text_pt: Ó Deus de meus pais, eu te dou graças e te louvo, porque me deste sabedoria e força; e agora me fizeste saber o que te pedimos, porque nos fizeste saber este assunto do rei.
text_el: σοί ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων μου ἐξομολογοῦμαι καὶ αἰνῶ ὅτι σοφίαν καὶ δύναμιν ἔδωκάς μοι καὶ νῦν ἐγνώρισάς μοι ἃ ἠξιώσαμεν παρὰ σοῦ καὶ τὸ ὅραμα τοῦ βασιλέως ἐγνώρισάς μοι

text_en: After this Daniel went in to Arioch, to whom the king had given orders to destroy the wise men of Babylon , and he spoke thus to him: Destroy not the wise men of Babylon : bring me in before the king, and I will tell the solution to the king.
text_la: Post hæc Daniel ingressus ad Arioch, quem constituerat rex ut perderet sapientes Babylonis, sic ei locutus est : Sapientes Babylonis ne perdas : introduc me in conspectu regis, et solutionem regi narrabo.
text_pt: Por isso Daniel foi ter com Arioque, ao qual o rei tinha constituído para matar os sábios de babilônia; entrou, e disse-lhe assim: Não mates os sábios de babilônia; introduze-me na presença do rei, e declararei ao rei a interpretação.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Δανιηλ πρὸς Αριωχ ὃν κατέστησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἀπολέσαι τοὺς σοφοὺς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τοὺς σοφοὺς Βαβυλῶνος μὴ ἀπολέσῃς εἰσάγαγε δέ με ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν τῷ βασιλεῖ ἀναγγελῶ

text_en: Then Arioch in haste brought in Daniel to the king, and said to him: I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Juda , that will resolve the question to the king.
text_la: Tunc Arioch festinus introduxit Danielem ad regem, et dixit ei : Inveni hominem de filiis transmigrationis Juda, qui solutionem regi annuntiet.
text_pt: Então Arioque depressa introduziu a Daniel na presença do rei, e disse-lhe assim: Achei um homem dentre os cativos de Judá, o qual fará saber ao rei a interpretação.
text_el: τότε Αριωχ ἐν σπουδῇ εἰσήγαγεν τὸν Δανιηλ ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εὕρηκα ἄνδρα ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας τῆς Ιουδαίας ὅστις τὸ σύγκριμα τῷ βασιλεῖ ἀναγγελεῖ

text_en: The king answered, and said to Daniel , whose name was Baltassar: Do you think indeed that you can tell me the dream that I saw, and the interpretation thereof?
text_la: Respondit rex, et dixit Danieli, cujus nomen erat Baltassar : Putasne vere potes mihi indicare somnium, quod vidi, et interpretationem ejus?
text_pt: Respondeu o rei, e disse a Daniel (cujo nome era Beltessazar): Podes tu fazer-me saber o sonho que tive e a sua interpretação?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Δανιηλ οὗ τὸ ὄνομα Βαλτασαρ εἰ δύνασαί μοι ἀναγγεῖλαι τὸ ἐνύπνιον ὃ εἶδον καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Daniel made answer before the king, and said: The secret that the king desires to know , none of the wise men , or the philosophers , or the diviners , or the soothsayers, can declare to the king.
text_la: Et respondens Daniel coram rege, ait : Mysterium, quod rex interrogat, sapientes, magi, arioli, et aruspices nequeunt indicare regi:
text_pt: Respondeu Daniel na presença do rei, dizendo: O segredo que o rei requer, nem sábios, nem astrólogos, nem magos, nem adivinhos o podem declarar ao rei;
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Δανιηλ ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ λέγει τὸ μυστήριον ὃ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐπερωτᾷ οὐκ ἔστιν σοφῶν μάγων ἐπαοιδῶν γαζαρηνῶν ἀναγγεῖλαι τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: But there is a God in heaven that reveals mysteries , who has shown to you, O King Nabuchodonosor , what is to come to pass in the latter times. Your dream, and the visions of your head upon your bed, are these:
text_la: sed est Deus in cælo revelans mysteria, qui indicavit tibi, rex Nabuchodonosor, quæ ventura sunt in novissimis temporibus. Somnium tuum, et visiones capitis tui in cubili tuo hujuscemodi sunt.
text_pt: Mas há um Deus no céu, o qual revela os mistérios; ele, pois, fez saber ao rei Nabucodonosor o que há de acontecer nos últimos dias; o teu sonho e as visões da tua cabeça que tiveste na tua cama são estes:
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ ἔστιν θεὸς ἐν οὐρανῷ ἀποκαλύπτων μυστήρια καὶ ἐγνώρισεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν τὸ ἐνύπνιόν σου καὶ αἱ ὁράσεις τῆς κεφαλῆς σου ἐπὶ τῆς κοίτης σου τοῦτό ἐστιν

text_en: You, O king, began to think in your bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that reveals mysteries showed you what shall come to pass.
text_la: Tu, rex, cogitare cœpisti in strato tuo, quid esset futurum post hæc : et qui revelat mysteria, ostendit tibi quæ ventura sunt.
text_pt: Estando tu, ó rei, na tua cama, subiram os teus pensamentos, acerca do que há de ser depois disto. Aquele, pois, que revela os mistérios te fez saber o que há de ser.
text_el: σὺ βασιλεῦ οἱ διαλογισμοί σου ἐπὶ τῆς κοίτης σου ἀνέβησαν τί δεῖ γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ὁ ἀποκαλύπτων μυστήρια ἐγνώρισέν σοι ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι

text_en: To me also this secret is revealed , not by any wisdom that I have more than all men alive: but that the interpretation might be made manifest to the king, and you might know the thoughts of your mind .
text_la: Mihi quoque non in sapientia, quæ est in me plus quam in cunctis viventibus, sacramentum hoc revelatum est : sed ut interpretatio regi manifesta fieret, et cogitationes mentis tuæ scires.
text_pt: E a mim me foi revelado esse mistério, não porque haja em mim mais sabedoria que em todos os viventes, mas para que a interpretação se fizesse saber ao rei, e para que entendesses os pensamentos do teu coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐμοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἐν σοφίᾳ τῇ οὔσῃ ἐν ἐμοὶ παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ζῶντας τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο ἀπεκαλύφθη ἀλλ' ἕνεκεν τοῦ τὴν σύγκρισιν τῷ βασιλεῖ γνωρίσαι ἵνα τοὺς διαλογισμοὺς τῆς καρδίας σου γνῷς

text_en: You, O king, saw, and behold there was as it were a great statue: this statue, which was great and high, tall of stature, stood before you, and the look thereof was terrible.
text_la: Tu, rex, videbas, et ecce quasi statua una grandis : statua illa magna, et statura sublimis stabat contra te, et intuitus ejus erat terribilis.
text_pt: Tu, ó rei, estavas vendo, e eis aqui uma grande estátua; esta estátua, que era imensa, cujo esplendor era excelente, e estava em pé diante de ti; e a sua aparência era terrível.
text_el: σύ βασιλεῦ ἐθεώρεις καὶ ἰδοὺ εἰκὼν μία μεγάλη ἡ εἰκὼν ἐκείνη καὶ ἡ πρόσοψις αὐτῆς ὑπερφερής ἑστῶσα πρὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἡ ὅρασις αὐτῆς φοβερά

text_en: The head of this statue was of fine gold, but the breast and the arms of silver, and the belly and the thighs of brass.
text_la: Hujus statuæ caput ex auro optimo erat, pectus autem et brachia de argento, porro venter et femora ex ære,
text_pt: A cabeça daquela estátua era de ouro fino; o seu peito e os seus braços de prata; o seu ventre e as suas coxas de cobre;
text_el: ἡ εἰκών ἧς ἡ κεφαλὴ χρυσίου χρηστοῦ αἱ χεῖρες καὶ τὸ στῆθος καὶ οἱ βραχίονες αὐτῆς ἀργυροῖ ἡ κοιλία καὶ οἱ μηροὶ χαλκοῖ

text_en: And the legs of iron, the feet part of iron and part of clay.
text_la: tibiæ autem ferreæ : pedum quædam pars erat ferrea, quædam autem fictilis.
text_pt: As pernas de ferro; os seus pés em parte de ferro e em parte de barro.
text_el: αἱ κνῆμαι σιδηραῖ οἱ πόδες μέρος τι σιδηροῦν καὶ μέρος τι ὀστράκινον

text_en: Thus you saw, till a stone was cut out of a mountain without hands: and it struck the statue upon the feet thereof that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.
text_la: Videbas ita, donec abscissus est lapis de monte sine manibus : et percussit statuam in pedibus ejus ferreis et fictilibus, et comminuit eos.
text_pt: Estavas vendo isto, quando uma pedra foi cortada, sem auxílio de mão, a qual feriu a estátua nos pés de ferro e de barro, e os esmiuçou.
text_el: ἐθεώρεις ἕως οὗ ἐτμήθη λίθος ἐξ ὄρους ἄνευ χειρῶν καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν εἰκόνα ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας τοὺς σιδηροῦς καὶ ὀστρακίνους καὶ ἐλέπτυνεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τέλος

text_en: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of a summer's threshing floor, and they were carried away by the wind: and there was no place found for them: but the stone that struck the statue became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
text_la: Tunc contrita sunt pariter ferrum, testa, æs, argentum, et aurum, et redacta quasi in favillam æstivæ areæ, quæ rapta sunt vento, nullusque locus inventus est eis : lapis autem, qui percusserat statuam, factus est mons magnus, et implevit universam terram.
text_pt: Então foi juntamente esmiuçado o ferro, o barro, o bronze, a prata e o ouro, os quais se fizeram como pragana das eiras do estio, e o vento os levou, e não se achou lugar algum para eles; mas a pedra, que feriu a estátua, se tornou grande monte, e encheu toda a terra.
text_el: τότε ἐλεπτύνθησαν εἰς ἅπαξ τὸ ὄστρακον ὁ σίδηρος ὁ χαλκός ὁ ἄργυρος ὁ χρυσὸς καὶ ἐγένοντο ὡσεὶ κονιορτὸς ἀπὸ ἅλωνος θερινῆς καὶ ἐξῆρεν αὐτὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ πνεύματος καὶ τόπος οὐχ εὑρέθη αὐτοῖς καὶ ὁ λίθος ὁ πατάξας τὴν εἰκόνα ἐγενήθη ὄρος μέγα καὶ ἐπλήρωσεν πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: This is the dream: we will also tell the interpretation thereof before you, O king.
text_la: Hoc est somnium : interpretationem quoque ejus dicemus coram te, rex.
text_pt: Este é o sonho; também a sua interpretação diremos na presença do rei.
text_el: τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ τὴν σύγκρισιν αὐτοῦ ἐροῦμεν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: You are a king of kings: and the God of heaven has given you a kingdom, and strength, and power, and glory :
text_la: Tu rex regum es : et Deus cæli regnum, et fortitudinem, et imperium, et gloriam dedit tibi:
text_pt: Tu, ó rei, és rei de reis; a quem o Deus do céu tem dado o reino, o poder, a força, e a glória.
text_el: σύ βασιλεῦ βασιλεὺς βασιλέων ᾧ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ βασιλείαν ἰσχυρὰν καὶ κραταιὰν καὶ ἔντιμον ἔδωκεν

text_en: And all places wherein the children of men , and the beasts of the field do dwell: he has also given the birds of the air into your hand, and has put all things under your power: you, therefore, are the head of gold.
text_la: et omnia, in quibus habitant filii hominum, et bestiæ agri : volucres quoque cæli dedit in manu tua, et sub ditione tua universa constituit : tu es ergo caput aureum.
text_pt: E onde quer que habitem os filhos de homens, na tua mão entregou os animais do campo, e as aves do céu, e fez que reinasse sobre todos eles; tu és a cabeça de ouro.
text_el: ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ὅπου κατοικοῦσιν οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων θηρία τε ἀγροῦ καὶ πετεινὰ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν ἐν τῇ χειρί σου καὶ κατέστησέν σε κύριον πάντων σὺ εἶ ἡ κεφαλὴ ἡ χρυσῆ

text_en: And after you shall rise up another kingdom, inferior to you, of silver: and another third kingdom of brass, which shall rule over all the world.
text_la: Et post te consurget regnum aliud minus te argenteum : et regnum tertium aliud æreum, quod imperabit universæ terræ.
text_pt: E depois de ti se levantará outro reino, inferior ao teu; e um terceiro reino, de bronze, o qual dominará sobre toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ὀπίσω σου ἀναστήσεται βασιλεία ἑτέρα ἥττων σου καὶ βασιλεία τρίτη ἥτις ἐστὶν ὁ χαλκός ἣ κυριεύσει πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the fourth kingdom shall be as iron. As iron breaks into pieces, and subdues all things, so shall that break, and destroy all these.
text_la: Et regnum quartum erit velut ferrum : quomodo ferrum comminuit, et domat omnia, sic comminuet, et conteret omnia hæc.
text_pt: E o quarto reino será forte como ferro; pois, como o ferro, esmiúça e quebra tudo; como o ferro que quebra todas as coisas, assim ele esmiuçará e fará em pedaços.
text_el: καὶ βασιλεία τετάρτη ἔσται ἰσχυρὰ ὡς ὁ σίδηρος ὃν τρόπον ὁ σίδηρος λεπτύνει καὶ δαμάζει πάντα οὕτως πάντα λεπτυνεῖ καὶ δαμάσει

text_en: And whereas you saw the feet, and the toes, part of potter's clay, and part of iron: the kingdom shall be divided, but yet it shall take its origin from the iron, according as you saw the iron mixed with the miry clay.
text_la: Porro quia vidisti pedum, et digitorum partem testæ figuli, et partem ferream, regnum divisum erit : quod tamen de plantario ferri orietur, secundum quod vidisti ferrum mistum testæ ex luto.
text_pt: E, quanto ao que viste dos pés e dos dedos, em parte de barro de oleiro, e em parte de ferro, isso será um reino dividido; contudo haverá nele alguma coisa da firmeza do ferro, pois viste o ferro misturado com barro de lodo.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι εἶδες τοὺς πόδας καὶ τοὺς δακτύλους μέρος μέν τι ὀστράκινον μέρος δέ τι σιδηροῦν βασιλεία διῃρημένη ἔσται καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ῥίζης τῆς σιδηρᾶς ἔσται ἐν αὐτῇ ὃν τρόπον εἶδες τὸν σίδηρον ἀναμεμειγμένον τῷ ὀστράκῳ

text_en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay: the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
text_la: Et digitos pedum ex parte ferreos, et ex parte fictiles : ex parte regnum erit solidum, et ex parte contritum.
text_pt: E como os dedos dos pés eram em parte de ferro e em parte de barro, assim por uma parte o reino será forte, e por outra será frágil.
text_el: καὶ οἱ δάκτυλοι τῶν ποδῶν μέρος μέν τι σιδηροῦν μέρος δέ τι ὀστράκινον μέρος τι τῆς βασιλείας ἔσται ἰσχυρὸν καὶ ἀπ' αὐτῆς ἔσται συντριβόμενον

text_en: And whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they shall be mingled indeed together with the seed of man , but they shall not stick fast one to another, as iron cannot be mixed with clay.
text_la: Quod autem vidisti ferrum mistum testæ ex luto, commiscebuntur quidem humano semine, sed non adhærebunt sibi, sicut ferrum misceri non potest testæ.
text_pt: Quanto ao que viste do ferro misturado com barro de lodo, misturar-se-ão com semente humana, mas não se ligarão um ao outro, assim como o ferro não se mistura com o barro.
text_el: ὅτι εἶδες τὸν σίδηρον ἀναμεμειγμένον τῷ ὀστράκῳ συμμειγεῖς ἔσονται ἐν σπέρματι ἀνθρώπων καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται προσκολλώμενοι οὗτος μετὰ τούτου καθὼς ὁ σίδηρος οὐκ ἀναμείγνυται μετὰ τοῦ ὀστράκου

text_en: But in the days of those kingdoms, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed, and his kingdom shall not be delivered up to another people: and it shall break in pieces, and shall consume all these kingdoms: and itself shall stand for ever.
text_la: In diebus autem regnorum illorum suscitabit Deus cæli regnum, quod in æternum non dissipabitur, et regnum ejus alteri populo non tradetur : comminuet autem, et consumet universa regna hæc, et ipsum stabit in æternum.
text_pt: Mas, nos dias desses reis, o Deus do céu levantará um reino que não será jamais destruído; e este reino não passará a outro povo; esmiuçará e consumirá todos esses reinos, mas ele mesmo subsistirá para sempre,
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῶν βασιλέων ἐκείνων ἀναστήσει ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ βασιλείαν ἥτις εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας οὐ διαφθαρήσεται καὶ ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ λαῷ ἑτέρῳ οὐχ ὑπολειφθήσεται λεπτυνεῖ καὶ λικμήσει πάσας τὰς βασιλείας καὶ αὐτὴ ἀναστήσεται εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: According as you saw, that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and broke in pieces the clay and the iron, and the brass, and the silver, and the gold, the great God has shown the king what shall come to pass hereafter, and the dream is true , and the interpretation thereof is faithful.
text_la: Secundum quod vidisti, quod de monte abscissus est lapis sine manibus, et comminuit testam, et ferrum, et æs, et argentum, et aurum, Deus magnus ostendit regi quæ ventura sunt postea : et verum est somnium, et fidelis interpretatio ejus.
text_pt: Da maneira que viste que do monte foi cortada uma pedra, sem auxílio de mãos, e ela esmiuçou o ferro, o bronze, o barro, a prata e o ouro; o grande Deus fez saber ao rei o que há de ser depois disto. Certo é o sonho, e fiel a sua interpretação.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον εἶδες ὅτι ἀπὸ ὄρους ἐτμήθη λίθος ἄνευ χειρῶν καὶ ἐλέπτυνεν τὸ ὄστρακον τὸν σίδηρον τὸν χαλκόν τὸν ἄργυρον τὸν χρυσόν ὁ θεὸς ὁ μέγας ἐγνώρισεν τῷ βασιλεῖ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἀληθινὸν τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ πιστὴ ἡ σύγκρισις αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then King Nabuchodonosor fell on his face, and worshipped Daniel , and commanded that they should offer in sacrifice to him victims and incense .
text_la: Tunc rex Nabuchodonosor cecidit in faciem suam, et Danielem adoravit, et hostias, et incensum præcepit ut sacrificarent ei.
text_pt: Então o rei Nabucodonosor caiu sobre a sua face, e adorou a Daniel, e ordenou que lhe oferecessem uma oblação e perfumes suaves.
text_el: τότε ὁ βασιλεὺς Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον καὶ τῷ Δανιηλ προσεκύνησεν καὶ μαναα καὶ εὐωδίας εἶπεν σπεῖσαι αὐτῷ

text_en: And the king spoke to Daniel , and said: Verily, your God is the God of gods, and Lord of kings, and a revealer of hidden things : seeing thou could discover this secret.
text_la: Loquens ergo rex, ait Danieli : Vere Deus vester Deus deorum est, et Dominus regum, et revelans mysteria : quoniam tu potuisti aperire hoc sacramentum.
text_pt: Respondeu o rei a Daniel, e disse: Certamente o vosso Deus é Deus dos deuses, e o Senhor dos reis e revelador de mistérios, pois pudeste revelar este mistério.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ βασιλεὺς εἶπεν τῷ Δανιηλ ἐπ' ἀληθείας ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν αὐτός ἐστιν θεὸς θεῶν καὶ κύριος τῶν βασιλέων καὶ ἀποκαλύπτων μυστήρια ὅτι ἠδυνήθης ἀποκαλύψαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο

text_en: Then the king advanced Daniel to a high station, and gave him many and great gifts: and he made him governor over all the provinces of Babylon : and chief of the magistrates over all the wise men of Babylon .
text_la: Tunc rex Danielem in sublime extulit, et munera multa et magna dedit ei : et constituit eum principem super omnes provincias Babylonis, et præfectum magistratuum super cunctos sapientes Babylonis.
text_pt: Então o rei engrandeceu a Daniel, e lhe deu muitas e grandes dádivas, e o pôs por governador de toda a província de babilônia, como também o fez chefe dos governadores sobre todos os sábios de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ἐμεγάλυνεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Δανιηλ καὶ δόματα μεγάλα καὶ πολλὰ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ πάσης χώρας Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἄρχοντα σατραπῶν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς σοφοὺς Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: And Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago, over the works of the province of Babylon : but Daniel himself was in the king's palace.
text_la: Daniel autem postulavit a rege, et constituit super opera provinciæ Babylonis Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago : ipse autem Daniel erat in foribus regis.
text_pt: E pediu Daniel ao rei, e constituiu ele sobre os negócios da província de babilônia a Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego; mas Daniel permaneceu na porta do rei.
text_el: καὶ Δανιηλ ᾐτήσατο παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ κατέστησεν ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῆς χώρας Βαβυλῶνος τὸν Σεδραχ Μισαχ Αβδεναγω καὶ Δανιηλ ἦν ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: King Nabuchodonosor made a statue of gold, of sixty cubits high, and six cubits broad, and he set it up in the plain of Dura, of the province of Babylon .
text_la: Nabuchodonosor rex fecit statuam auream, altitudine cubitorum sexaginta, latitudine cubitorum sex, et statuit eam in campo Dura, provinciæ Babylonis.
text_pt: O rei Nabucodonosor fez uma estátua de ouro, cuja altura era de sessenta côvados, e a sua largura de seis côvados; levantou-a no campo de Dura, na província de babilônia.
text_el: ἔτους ὀκτωκαιδεκάτου Ναβουχοδονοσορ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐποίησεν εἰκόνα χρυσῆν ὕψος αὐτῆς πήχεων ἑξήκοντα εὖρος αὐτῆς πήχεων ἕξ καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὴν ἐν πεδίῳ Δεϊρα ἐν χώρᾳ Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: Then Nabuchodonosor, the king , sent to call together the nobles, the magistrates, and the judges, the captains , the rulers, and governors, and all the chief men of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the statue which King Nabuchodonosor had set up.
text_la: Itaque Nabuchodonosor rex misit ad congregandos satrapas, magistratus, et judices, duces, et tyrannos, et præfectos, omnesque principes regionum, ut convenirent ad dedicationem statuæ quam erexerat Nabuchodonosor rex.
text_pt: Então o rei Nabucodonosor mandou reunir os príncipes, os prefeitos, os governadores, os conselheiros, os tesoureiros, os juízes, os capitàes, e todos os oficiais das províncias, para que viessem à consagração da estátua que o rei Nabucodonosor tinha levantado.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν συναγαγεῖν τοὺς ὑπάτους καὶ τοὺς στρατηγοὺς καὶ τοὺς τοπάρχας ἡγουμένους καὶ τυράννους καὶ τοὺς ἐπ' ἐξουσιῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν χωρῶν ἐλθεῖν εἰς τὰ ἐγκαίνια τῆς εἰκόνος ἧς ἔστησεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ ὁ βασιλεύς

text_en: Then the nobles, the magistrates, and the judges, the captains , and rulers, and the great men that were placed in authority, and all the princes of the provinces, were gathered together to come to the dedication of the statue, which King Nabuchodonosor had set up. And they stood before the statue which King Nabuchodonosor had set up.
text_la: Tunc congregati sunt satrapæ, magistratus, et judices, duces, et tyranni, et optimates, qui erant in potestatibus constituti, et universi principes regionum, ut convenirent ad dedicationem statuæ, quam erexerat Nabuchodonosor rex. Stabant autem in conspectu statuæ, quam posuerat Nabuchodonosor rex:
text_pt: Então se reuniram os príncipes, os prefeitos e governadores, os capitàes, os juízes, os tesoureiros, os conselheiros, e todos os oficiais das províncias, à consagração da estátua que o rei Nabucodonosor tinha levantado; e estavam em pé diante da imagem que Nabucodonosor tinha levantado.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν οἱ τοπάρχαι ὕπατοι στρατηγοί ἡγούμενοι τύραννοι μεγάλοι οἱ ἐπ' ἐξουσιῶν καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν χωρῶν εἰς τὸν ἐγκαινισμὸν τῆς εἰκόνος ἧς ἔστησεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ ὁ βασιλεύς καὶ εἱστήκεισαν ἐνώπιον τῆς εἰκόνος ἧς ἔστησεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ

text_en: Then a herald cried with a strong voice: To you it is commanded, O nations, tribes and languages:
text_la: et præco clamabat valenter : Vobis dicitur populis, tribubus, et linguis:
text_pt: E o arauto apregoava em alta voz: Ordena-se a vós, ó povos, nações e línguas:
text_el: καὶ ὁ κῆρυξ ἐβόα ἐν ἰσχύι ὑμῖν λέγεται λαοί φυλαί γλῶσσαι

text_en: That in the hour that you shall hear the sound of the trumpet, and of the flute, and of the harp, of the sackbut, and of the psaltery , and of the symphony, and of all kind of music, you fall down and adore the golden statue which King Nabuchodonosor has set up.
text_la: in hora qua audieritis sonitum tubæ, et fistulæ, et citharæ, sambucæ, et psalterii, et symphoniæ, et universi generis musicorum, cadentes adorate statuam auream, quam constituit Nabuchodonosor rex.
text_pt: Quando ouvirdes o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério, da gaita de foles, e de toda a espécie de música, prostrar-vos-eis, e adorareis a estátua de ouro que o rei Nabucodonosor tem levantado.
text_el: ᾗ ἂν ὥρᾳ ἀκούσητε τῆς φωνῆς τῆς σάλπιγγος σύριγγός τε καὶ κιθάρας σαμβύκης καὶ ψαλτηρίου καὶ συμφωνίας καὶ παντὸς γένους μουσικῶν πίπτοντες προσκυνεῖτε τῇ εἰκόνι τῇ χρυσῇ ᾗ ἔστησεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ ὁ βασιλεύς

text_en: But if any man shall not fall down and adore , he shall the same hour be cast into a furnace of burning fire.
text_la: Si quis autem non prostratus adoraverit, eadem hora mittetur in fornacem ignis ardentis.
text_pt: E qualquer que não se prostrar e não a adorar, será na mesma hora lançado dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ πεσὼν προσκυνήσῃ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐμβληθήσεται εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρὸς τὴν καιομένην

text_en: Upon this, therefore, at the time when all the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the flute, and the harp, of the sackbut, and the psaltery , of the symphony, and of all kind of music, all the nations, tribes, and languages fell down and adored the golden statue which King Nabuchodonosor had set up.
text_la: Post hæc igitur, statim ut audierunt omnes populi sonitum tubæ, fistulæ, et citharæ, sambucæ, et psalterii, et symphoniæ, et omnis generis musicorum, cadentes omnes populi, tribus, et linguæ adoraverunt statuam auream, quam constituerat Nabuchodonosor rex.
text_pt: Portanto, no mesmo instante em que todos os povos ouviram o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério e de toda a espécie de música, prostraram-se todos os povos, nações e línguas, e adoraram a estátua de ouro que o rei Nabucodonosor tinha levantado.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἤκουσαν οἱ λαοὶ τῆς φωνῆς τῆς σάλπιγγος σύριγγός τε καὶ κιθάρας σαμβύκης καὶ ψαλτηρίου καὶ συμφωνίας καὶ παντὸς γένους μουσικῶν πίπτοντες πάντες οἱ λαοί φυλαί γλῶσσαι προσεκύνουν τῇ εἰκόνι τῇ χρυσῇ ᾗ ἔστησεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ ὁ βασιλεύς

text_en: And presently at that very time some Chaldeans came and accused the Jews ,
text_la: Statimque in ipso tempore accedentes viri Chaldæi accusaverunt Judæos:
text_pt: Por isso, no mesmo instante chegaram perto alguns caldeus, e acusaram os judeus.
text_el: τότε προσήλθοσαν ἄνδρες Χαλδαῖοι καὶ διέβαλον τοὺς Ιουδαίους

text_en: and said to King Nabuchodonosor : O king, live for ever:
text_la: dixeruntque Nabuchodonosor regi : Rex, in æternum vive!
text_pt: E responderam, dizendo ao rei Nabucodonosor: Ó rei, vive eternamente!
text_el: τῷ βασιλεῖ Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεῦ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ζῆθι

text_en: You, O king, have made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the trumpet, the flute, and the harp, of the sackbut, and the psaltery , of the symphony, and of all kind of music, shall prostrate himself, and adore the golden statue:
text_la: tu, rex, posuisti decretum, ut omnis homo, qui audierit sonitum tubæ, fistulæ, et citharæ, sambucæ, et psalterii, et symphoniæ, et universi generis musicorum, prosternat se, et adoret statuam auream:
text_pt: Tu, ó rei, fizeste um decreto, pelo qual todo homem que ouvisse o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério, e da gaita de foles, e de toda a espécie de música, se prostrasse e adorasse a estátua de ouro;
text_el: σύ βασιλεῦ ἔθηκας δόγμα πάντα ἄνθρωπον ὃς ἂν ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς τῆς σάλπιγγος σύριγγός τε καὶ κιθάρας σαμβύκης καὶ ψαλτηρίου καὶ συμφωνίας καὶ παντὸς γένους μουσικῶν

text_en: And that if any man shall not fall down and adore , he should be cast into a furnace of burning fire.
text_la: si quis autem non procidens adoraverit, mittatur in fornacem ignis ardentis.
text_pt: E, qualquer que não se prostrasse e adorasse, seria lançado dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.
text_el: καὶ μὴ πεσὼν προσκυνήσῃ τῇ εἰκόνι τῇ χρυσῇ ἐμβληθήσεται εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρὸς τὴν καιομένην

text_en: Now there are certain Jews , whom you have set over the works of the province of Babylon , Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago: these men, O king, have slighted your decree: they worship not your gods, nor do they adore the golden statue which you have set up.
text_la: Sunt ergo viri Judæi, quos constituisti super opera regionis Babylonis, Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago : viri isti contempserunt, rex, decretum tuum : deos tuos non colunt, et statuam auream, quam erexisti, non adorant.
text_pt: Há uns homens judeus, os quais constituíste sobre os negócios da província de babilônia: Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego; estes homens, ó rei, não fizeram caso de ti; a teus deuses não servem, nem adoram a estátua de ouro que levantaste.
text_el: εἰσὶν ἄνδρες Ιουδαῖοι οὓς κατέστησας ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῆς χώρας Βαβυλῶνος Σεδραχ Μισαχ Αβδεναγω οἱ ἄνδρες ἐκεῖνοι οὐχ ὑπήκουσαν βασιλεῦ τῷ δόγματί σου τοῖς θεοῖς σου οὐ λατρεύουσιν καὶ τῇ εἰκόνι τῇ χρυσῇ ᾗ ἔστησας οὐ προσκυνοῦσιν

text_en: Then Nabuchodonosor in fury , and in wrath , commanded that Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago should be brought: who immediately were brought before the king.
text_la: Tunc Nabuchodonosor, in furore et in ira, præcepit ut adducerentur Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago : qui confestim adducti sunt in conspectu regis.
text_pt: Então Nabucodonosor, com ira e furor, mandou trazer a Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego. E trouxeram a estes homens perante o rei.
text_el: τότε Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἐν θυμῷ καὶ ὀργῇ εἶπεν ἀγαγεῖν τὸν Σεδραχ Μισαχ καὶ Αβδεναγω καὶ ἤχθησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Nabuchodonosor, the king , spoke to them, and said: Is it true , O Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago, that you do not worship my gods, nor adore the golden statue that I have set up?
text_la: Pronuntiansque Nabuchodonosor rex, ait eis : Verene Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago, deos meos non colitis, et statuam auream, quam constitui, non adoratis?
text_pt: Falou Nabucodonosor, e lhes disse: É de propósito, ó Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, que vós não servis a meus deuses nem adorais a estátua de ouro que levantei?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Ναβουχοδονοσορ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εἰ ἀληθῶς Σεδραχ Μισαχ Αβδεναγω τοῖς θεοῖς μου οὐ λατρεύετε καὶ τῇ εἰκόνι τῇ χρυσῇ ᾗ ἔστησα οὐ προσκυνεῖτε

text_en: Now, therefore, if you be ready, at what hour soever, you shall hear the sound of the trumpet, flute, harp, sackbut, and psaltery , and symphony, and of all kind of music, prostrate yourselves, and adore the statue which I have made: but if you do not adore , you shall be cast the same hour into the furnace of burning fire: and who is the God that shall deliver you out of my hand?
text_la: nunc ergo si estis parati, quacumque hora audieritis sonitum tubæ, fistulæ, citharæ, sambucæ, et psalterii, et symphoniæ, omnisque generis musicorum, prosternite vos, et adorate statuam, quam feci : quod si non adoraveritis, eadem hora mittemini in fornacem ignis ardentis : et quis est Deus, qui eripiet vos de manu mea?
text_pt: Agora, pois, se estais prontos, quando ouvirdes o som da buzina, da flauta, da harpa, da sambuca, do saltério, da gaita de foles, e de toda a espécie de música, para vos prostrardes e adorardes a estátua que fiz, bom é; mas, se não a adorardes, sereis lançados, na mesma hora, dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente. E quem é o Deus que vos poderá livrar das minhas mãos?
text_el: νῦν οὖν εἰ ἔχετε ἑτοίμως ἵνα ὡς ἂν ἀκούσητε τῆς φωνῆς τῆς σάλπιγγος σύριγγός τε καὶ κιθάρας σαμβύκης καὶ ψαλτηρίου καὶ συμφωνίας καὶ παντὸς γένους μουσικῶν πεσόντες προσκυνήσητε τῇ εἰκόνι ᾗ ἐποίησα ἐὰν δὲ μὴ προσκυνήσητε αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐμβληθήσεσθε εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρὸς τὴν καιομένην καὶ τίς ἐστιν θεός ὃς ἐξελεῖται ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν μου

text_en: Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago, answered, and said to King Nabuchodonosor : We have no occasion to answer you concerning this matter.
text_la: Respondentes Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago, dixerunt regi Nabuchodonosor : Non oportet nos de hac re respondere tibi.
text_pt: Responderam Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, e disseram ao rei Nabucodonosor: Não necessitamos de te responder sobre este negócio.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν Σεδραχ Μισαχ Αβδεναγω λέγοντες τῷ βασιλεῖ Ναβουχοδονοσορ οὐ χρείαν ἔχομεν ἡμεῖς περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου ἀποκριθῆναί σοι

text_en: For behold our God , whom we worship, is able to save us from the furnace of burning fire, and to deliver us out of your hands, O king.
text_la: Ecce enim Deus noster, quem colimus, potest eripere nos de camino ignis ardentis, et de manibus tuis, o rex, liberare.
text_pt: Eis que o nosso Deus, a quem nós servimos, é que nos pode livrar; ele nos livrará da fornalha de fogo ardente, e da tua mão, ó rei.
text_el: ἔστιν γὰρ θεός ᾧ ἡμεῖς λατρεύομεν δυνατὸς ἐξελέσθαι ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς καμίνου τοῦ πυρὸς τῆς καιομένης καὶ ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν σου βασιλεῦ ῥύσεται ἡμᾶς

text_en: But if he will not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not worship your gods, nor adore the golden statue which you have set up.
text_la: Quod si noluerit, notum sit tibi, rex, quia deos tuos non colimus, et statuam auream, quam erexisti, non adoramus.
text_pt: E, se não, fica sabendo ó rei, que não serviremos a teus deuses nem adoraremos a estátua de ouro que levantaste.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν μή γνωστὸν ἔστω σοι βασιλεῦ ὅτι τοῖς θεοῖς σου οὐ λατρεύομεν καὶ τῇ εἰκόνι τῇ χρυσῇ ᾗ ἔστησας οὐ προσκυνοῦμεν

text_en: Then was Nabuchodonosor filled with fury : and the countenance of his face was changed against Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago, and he commanded that the furnace should be heated seven times more than it had been accustomed to be heated.
text_la: Tunc Nabuchodonosor repletus est furore, et aspectus faciei illius immutatus est super Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago : et præcepit ut succenderetur fornax septuplum quam succendi consueverat.
text_pt: Então Nabucodonosor se encheu de furor, e mudou-se o aspecto do seu semblante contra Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego; falou, e ordenou que a fornalha se aquecesse sete vezes mais do que se costumava aquecer.
text_el: τότε Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἐπλήσθη θυμοῦ καὶ ἡ ὄψις τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἠλλοιώθη ἐπὶ Σεδραχ Μισαχ καὶ Αβδεναγω καὶ εἶπεν ἐκκαῦσαι τὴν κάμινον ἑπταπλασίως ἕως οὗ εἰς τέλος ἐκκαῇ

text_en: And he commanded the strongest men that were in his army, to bind the feet of Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago, and to cast them into the furnace of burning fire.
text_la: Et viris fortissimis de exercitu suo jussit ut ligatis pedibus Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago, mitterent eos in fornacem ignis ardentis.
text_pt: E ordenou aos homens mais poderosos, que estavam no seu exército, que atassem a Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, para lançá-los na fornalha de fogo ardente.
text_el: καὶ ἄνδρας ἰσχυροὺς ἰσχύι εἶπεν πεδήσαντας τὸν Σεδραχ Μισαχ καὶ Αβδεναγω ἐμβαλεῖν εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρὸς τὴν καιομένην

text_en: And immediately these men were bound, and were cast into the furnace of burning fire, with their coats, and their caps, and their shoes, and their garments.
text_la: Et confestim viri illi vincti, cum braccis suis, et tiaris, et calceamentis, et vestibus, missi sunt in medium fornacis ignis ardentis:
text_pt: Então estes homens foram atados, vestidos com as suas capas, suas túnicas, e seus chapéus, e demais roupas, e foram lançados dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.
text_el: τότε οἱ ἄνδρες ἐκεῖνοι ἐπεδήθησαν σὺν τοῖς σαραβάροις αὐτῶν καὶ τιάραις καὶ περικνημῖσι καὶ ἐνδύμασιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβλήθησαν εἰς μέσον τῆς καμίνου τοῦ πυρὸς τῆς καιομένης

text_en: For the king's commandment was urgent, and the furnace was heated exceedingly. And the flame of the fire slew those men that had cast in Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago.
text_la: nam jussio regis urgebat. Fornax autem succensa erat nimis : porro viros illos, qui miserant Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago, interfecit flamma ignis.
text_pt: E, porque a palavra do rei era urgente, e a fornalha estava sobremaneira quente, a chama do fogo matou aqueles homens que carregaram a Sadraque, Mesaque, e Abednego.
text_el: ἐπεὶ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦ βασιλέως ὑπερίσχυεν καὶ ἡ κάμινος ἐξεκαύθη ἐκ περισσοῦ

text_en: But these three men, that is, Sidrach, Misach, and Abdenago, fell down bound in the midst of the furnace of burning fire.
text_la: Viri autem hi tres, id est, Sidrach, Misach, et Abdenago, ceciderunt in medio camino ignis ardentis, colligati.
text_pt: E estes três homens, Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, caíram atados dentro da fornalha de fogo ardente.
text_el: καὶ οἱ τρεῖς οὗτοι Σεδραχ Μισαχ καὶ Αβδεναγω ἔπεσον εἰς μέσον τῆς καμίνου τοῦ πυρὸς τῆς καιομένης πεπεδημένοι

text_en: And they walked in the midst of the flame, praising God , and blessing the Lord .
text_la: Et ambulabant in medio flammæ, laudantes Deum, et benedicentes Domino.
text_pt: Então o rei Nabucodonosor se espantou, e se levantou depressa; falou, dizendo aos seus conselheiros: Não lançamos nós, dentro do fogo, três homens atados? Responderam e disseram ao rei: É verdade, ó rei.
text_el: καὶ περιεπάτουν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς φλογὸς ὑμνοῦντες τὸν θεὸν καὶ εὐλογοῦντες τὸν κύριον

text_en: Then Azarias standing up, prayed in this manner, and opening his mouth in the midst of the fire, he said:
text_la: Stans autem Azarias oravit sic, aperiensque os suum in medio ignis, ait:
text_pt: Respondeu, dizendo: Eu, porém, vejo quatro homens soltos, que andam passeando dentro do fogo, sem sofrer nenhum dano; e o aspecto do quarto é semelhante ao Filho de Deus.
text_el: καὶ συστὰς Αζαριας προσηύξατο οὕτως καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ πυρὸς εἶπεν

text_en: Blessed are you, O Lord , the God of our fathers, and your name is worthy of praise, and glorious for ever:
text_la: Benedictus es, Domine Deus patrum nostrorum, et laudabile, et gloriosum nomen tuum in sæcula :
text_pt: Então chegando-se Nabucodonosor à porta da fornalha de fogo ardente, falou, dizendo: Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, servos do Deus Altíssimo, saí e vinde! Então Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego saíram do meio do fogo.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς εἶ κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ αἰνετός καὶ δεδοξασμένον τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: For you are just in all that you have done to us, and all your works are true , and your ways right, and all your judgments true .
text_la: quia justus es in omnibus, quæ fecisti nobis, et universa opera tua vera, et viæ tuæ rectæ, et omnia judicia tua vera.
text_pt: E reuniram-se os príncipes, os capitàes, os governadores e os conselheiros do rei e, contemplando estes homens, viram que o fogo não tinha tido poder algum sobre os seus corpos; nem um só cabelo da sua cabeça se tinha queimado, nem as suas capas se mudaram, nem cheiro de fogo tinha passado sobre eles.
text_el: ὅτι δίκαιος εἶ ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐποίησας ἡμῖν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα σου ἀληθινά καὶ εὐθεῖαι αἱ ὁδοί σου καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ κρίσεις σου ἀλήθεια

text_en: For you have executed true judgments in all the things that you have brought upon us, and upon Jerusalem , the holy city of our fathers: for according to truth and judgment, you have brought all these things upon us for our sins .
text_la: Judicia enim vera fecisti juxta omnia, quæ induxisti super nos, et super civitatem sanctam patrum nostrorum Jerusalem : quia in veritate et in judicio induxisti omnia hæc propter peccata nostra.
text_pt: Falou Nabucodonosor, dizendo: Bendito seja o Deus de Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, que enviou o seu anjo, e livrou os seus servos, que confiaram nele, pois violaram a palavra do rei, preferindo entregar os seus corpos, para que não servissem nem adorassem algum outro deus, senão o seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ κρίματα ἀληθείας ἐποίησας κατὰ πάντα ἃ ἐπήγαγες ἡμῖν καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἁγίαν τὴν τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ κρίσει ἐπήγαγες πάντα ταῦτα διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν

text_en: For we have sinned , and committed iniquity , departing from you: and we have trespassed in all things:
text_la: Peccavimus enim, et inique egimus recedentes a te, et deliquimus in omnibus :
text_pt: Por mim, pois, é feito um decreto, pelo qual todo o povo, e nação e língua que disser blasfêmia contra o Deus de Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, seja despedaçado, e as suas casas sejam feitas um monturo; porquanto não há outro Deus que possa livrar como este.
text_el: ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν καὶ ἠνομήσαμεν ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἐξημάρτομεν ἐν πᾶσιν καὶ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου οὐκ ἠκούσαμεν

text_en: And we have not hearkened to your commandments , nor have we observed nor done as you had commanded us, that it might go well with us.
text_la: et præcepta tua non audivimus, nec observavimus, nec fecimus sicut præceperas nobis ut bene nobis esset.
text_pt: Então o rei fez prosperar a Sadraque, Mesaque e Abednego, na província de babilônia.
text_el: οὐδὲ συνετηρήσαμεν οὐδὲ ἐποιήσαμεν καθὼς ἐνετείλω ἡμῖν ἵνα εὖ ἡμῖν γένηται

text_en: Wherefore, all that you have brought upon us, and everything that you have done to us, you have done in true judgment:
text_la: Omnia ergo, quæ induxisti super nos, et universa quæ fecisti nobis, in vero judicio fecisti;
text_el: καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἡμῖν ἐπήγαγες καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησας ἡμῖν ἐν ἀληθινῇ κρίσει ἐποίησας

text_en: And you have delivered us into the hands of our enemies that are unjust , and most wicked , and prevaricators, and to a king unjust , and most wicked beyond all that are upon the earth.
text_la: et tradidisti nos in manibus inimicorum nostrorum iniquorum, et pessimorum, prævaricatorumque, et regi injusto, et pessimo ultra omnem terram.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκας ἡμᾶς εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθρῶν ἀνόμων ἐχθίστων ἀποστατῶν καὶ βασιλεῖ ἀδίκῳ καὶ πονηροτάτῳ παρὰ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: And now we cannot open our mouths: we have become a shame, and a reproach to your servants, and to them that worship you.
text_la: Et nunc non possumus aperire os : confusio, et opprobrium facti sumus servis tuis, et his qui colunt te.
text_el: καὶ νῦν οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἀνοῖξαι τὸ στόμα αἰσχύνη καὶ ὄνειδος ἐγενήθη τοῖς δούλοις σου καὶ τοῖς σεβομένοις σε

text_en: Deliver us not up for ever, we beseech you, for your name's sake, and abolish not your covenant.
text_la: Ne, quæsumus, tradas nos in perpetuum propter nomen tuum, et ne dissipes testamentum tuum :
text_el: μὴ δὴ παραδῷς ἡμᾶς εἰς τέλος διὰ τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ μὴ διασκεδάσῃς τὴν διαθήκην σου

text_en: And take not away your mercy from us, for the sake of Abraham , your beloved, and Isaac , your servant, and Israel , your holy one:
text_la: neque auferas misericordiam tuam a nobis, propter Abraham, dilectum tuum, et Isaac, servum tuum, et Israël, sanctum tuum,
text_el: καὶ μὴ ἀποστήσῃς τὸ ἔλεός σου ἀφ' ἡμῶν δι' Αβρααμ τὸν ἠγαπημένον ὑπὸ σοῦ καὶ διὰ Ισαακ τὸν δοῦλόν σου καὶ Ισραηλ τὸν ἅγιόν σου

text_en: To whom you have spoken, promising that you would multiply their seed as the stars of heaven , and as the sand that is on the sea shore.
text_la: quibus locutus es pollicens quod multiplicares semen eorum sicut stellas cæli, et sicut arenam quæ est in littore maris;
text_el: οἷς ἐλάλησας πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων πληθῦναι τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ὡς τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὡς τὴν ἄμμον τὴν παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης

text_en: For we, O Lord , are diminished more than any nation, and are brought low in all the earth this day for our sins .
text_la: quia, Domine, imminuti sumus plus quam omnes gentes, sumusque humiles in universa terra hodie propter peccata nostra.
text_el: ὅτι δέσποτα ἐσμικρύνθημεν παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καί ἐσμεν ταπεινοὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ σήμερον διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν

text_en: Neither is there at this time prince, or leader, or prophet , or holocaust , or sacrifice , or oblation , or incense , or place of first fruits before you,
text_la: Et non est in tempore hoc princeps, et dux, et propheta, neque holocaustum, neque sacrificium, neque oblatio, neque incensum, neque locus primitiarum coram te,
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ ἄρχων καὶ προφήτης καὶ ἡγούμενος οὐδὲ ὁλοκαύτωσις οὐδὲ θυσία οὐδὲ προσφορὰ οὐδὲ θυμίαμα οὐ τόπος τοῦ καρπῶσαι ἐναντίον σου καὶ εὑρεῖν ἔλεος

text_en: that we may find your mercy: nevertheless, in a contrite heart and humble spirit let us be accepted.
text_la: ut possimus invenire misericordiam tuam, sed in animo contrito, et spiritu humilitatis suscipiamur.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἐν ψυχῇ συντετριμμένῃ καὶ πνεύματι ταπεινώσεως προσδεχθείημεν ὡς ἐν ὁλοκαυτώμασιν κριῶν καὶ ταύρων καὶ ὡς ἐν μυριάσιν ἀρνῶν πιόνων

text_en: As in holocausts of rams, and bullocks, and as in thousands of fat lambs: so let our sacrifice be made in your sight this day, that it may please you: for there is no confusion to them that trust in you.
text_la: Sicut in holocausto arietum, et taurorum, et sicut in millibus agnorum pinguium, sic fiat sacrificium nostrum in conspectu tuo hodie, ut placeat tibi, quoniam non est confusio confidentibus in te.
text_el: οὕτως γενέσθω θυσία ἡμῶν ἐνώπιόν σου σήμερον καὶ ἐκτελέσαι ὄπισθέν σου ὅτι οὐκ ἔσται αἰσχύνη τοῖς πεποιθόσιν ἐπὶ σοί

text_en: And now we follow you with all our heart, and we fear you, and seek your face.
text_la: Et nunc sequimur te in toto corde; et timemus te, et quærimus faciem tuam.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐξακολουθοῦμεν ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ καὶ φοβούμεθά σε καὶ ζητοῦμεν τὸ πρόσωπόν σου μὴ καταισχύνῃς ἡμᾶς

text_en: Put us not to confusion, but deal with us according to your meekness, and according to the multitude of your mercies.
text_la: Nec confundas nos, sed fac nobiscum juxta mansuetudinem tuam, et secundum multitudinem misericordiæ tuæ.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ποίησον μεθ' ἡμῶν κατὰ τὴν ἐπιείκειάν σου καὶ κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους σου

text_en: And deliver us, according to your wonderful works, and give glory to your name , O Lord :
text_la: Et erue nos in mirabilibus tuis, et da gloriam nomini tuo, Domine;
text_el: καὶ ἐξελοῦ ἡμᾶς κατὰ τὰ θαυμάσιά σου καὶ δὸς δόξαν τῷ ὀνόματί σου κύριε

text_en: And let all them be confounded that show evils to your servants, let them be confounded in all your might, and let their strength be broken:
text_la: et confundantur omnes qui ostendunt servis tuis mala : confundantur in omni potentia tua, et robur eorum conteratur :
text_el: καὶ ἐντραπείησαν πάντες οἱ ἐνδεικνύμενοι τοῖς δούλοις σου κακὰ καὶ καταισχυνθείησαν ἀπὸ πάσης δυνάμεως καὶ δυναστείας καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτῶν συντριβείη

text_en: And let them know that you are the Lord , the only God , and glorious over all the world.
text_la: et sciant quia tu es Dominus Deus solus, et gloriosus super orbem terrarum.
text_el: γνώτωσαν ὅτι σὺ εἶ κύριος ὁ θεὸς μόνος καὶ ἔνδοξος ἐφ' ὅλην τὴν οἰκουμένην

text_en: Now the king's servants that had cast them in, ceased not to heat the furnace with brimstone and tow, and pitch, and dry sticks,
text_la: Et non cessabant qui miserant eos ministri regis succendere fornacem, naphtha, et stuppa, et pice, et malleolis,
text_el: καὶ οὐ διέλειπον οἱ ἐμβαλόντες αὐτοὺς ὑπηρέται τοῦ βασιλέως καίοντες τὴν κάμινον νάφθαν καὶ πίσσαν καὶ στιππύον καὶ κληματίδα

text_en: and the flame mounted up above the furnace nine and forty cubits:
text_la: et effundebatur flamma super fornacem cubitis quadraginta novem:
text_el: καὶ διεχεῖτο ἡ φλὸξ ἐπάνω τῆς καμίνου ἐπὶ πήχεις τεσσαράκοντα ἐννέα

text_en: And it broke forth, and burnt such of the Chaldeans as it found near the furnace.
text_la: et erupit, et incendit quos reperit juxta fornacem de Chaldæis.
text_el: καὶ διώδευσεν καὶ ἐνεπύρισεν οὓς εὗρεν περὶ τὴν κάμινον τῶν Χαλδαίων

text_en: But the angel of the Lord went down with Azarias and his companions into the furnace: and he drove the flame of the fire out of the furnace,
text_la: Angelus autem Domini descendit cum Azaria, et sociis ejus in fornacem : et excussit flammam ignis de fornace,
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἄγγελος κυρίου συγκατέβη ἅμα τοῖς περὶ τὸν Αζαριαν εἰς τὴν κάμινον καὶ ἐξετίναξεν τὴν φλόγα τοῦ πυρὸς ἐκ τῆς καμίνου

text_en: and made the midst of the furnace like the blowing of a wind bringing dew, and the fire touched them not at all, nor troubled them, nor did them any harm.
text_la: et fecit medium fornacis quasi ventum roris flantem, et non tetigit eos omnino ignis, neque contristavit, nec quidquam molestiæ intulit.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ μέσον τῆς καμίνου ὡς πνεῦμα δρόσου διασυρίζον καὶ οὐχ ἥψατο αὐτῶν τὸ καθόλου τὸ πῦρ καὶ οὐκ ἐλύπησεν οὐδὲ παρηνώχλησεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Then these three, as with one mouth, praised and glorified and blessed God , in the furnace, saying:
text_la: Tunc hi tres quasi ex uno ore laudabant, et glorificabant, et benedicebant Deum in fornace, dicentes:
text_el: τότε οἱ τρεῖς ὡς ἐξ ἑνὸς στόματος ὕμνουν καὶ ἐδόξαζον καὶ εὐλόγουν τὸν θεὸν ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ λέγοντες

text_en: Blessed are you, O Lord , the God of our fathers; and worthy to be praised, and glorified , and exalted above all for ever: and blessed is the holy name of your glory : and worthy to be praised and exalted above all, in all ages.
text_la: Benedictus es, Domine Deus patrum nostrorum : et laudabilis, et gloriosus, et superexaltatus in sæcula. Et benedictum nomen gloriæ tuæ sanctum : et laudabile, et superexaltatum in omnibus sæculis.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς εἶ κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ αἰνετὸς καὶ ὑπερυψούμενος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας καὶ εὐλογημένον τὸ ὄνομα τῆς δόξης σου τὸ ἅγιον καὶ ὑπεραινετὸν καὶ ὑπερυψούμενον εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: Blessed are you in the holy temple of your glory : and exceedingly to be praised, and exceeding glorious for ever.
text_la: Benedictus es in templo sancto gloriæ tuæ : et superlaudabilis, et supergloriosus in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογημένος εἶ ἐν τῷ ναῷ τῆς ἁγίας δόξης σου καὶ ὑπερυμνητὸς καὶ ὑπερένδοξος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: Blessed are you on the throne of your kingdom, and exceedingly to be praised, and exalted above all for ever.
text_la: Benedictus es in throno regni tui : et superlaudabilis, et superexaltatus in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογημένος εἶ ἐπὶ θρόνου τῆς βασιλείας σου καὶ ὑπερυμνητὸς καὶ ὑπερυψούμενος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: Blessed are you, that behold the depths, and sit upon the cherubims : and worthy to be praised and exalted above all for ever.
text_la: Benedictus es, qui intueris abyssos, et sedes super cherubim : et laudabilis, et superexaltatus in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογημένος εἶ ὁ ἐπιβλέπων ἀβύσσους καθήμενος ἐπὶ χερουβιν καὶ αἰνετὸς καὶ ὑπερυψούμενος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: Blessed are you in the firmament of heaven : and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.
text_la: Benedictus es in firmamento cæli : et laudabilis et gloriosus in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογημένος εἶ ἐν τῷ στερεώματι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὑμνητὸς καὶ δεδοξασμένος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: All you works of the Lord , bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, omnia opera Domini, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πάντα τὰ ἔργα κυρίου τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you angels of the Lord , bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, angeli Domini, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ἄγγελοι κυρίου τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you heavens , bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, cæli, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε οὐρανοί τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O all you waters that are above the heavens , bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ὕδατα πάντα τὰ ἐπάνω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O all you powers of the Lord , bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, omnes virtutes Domini, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you sun and moon, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, sol et luna, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ἥλιος καὶ σελήνη τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you stars of heaven, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, stellæ cæli, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O every shower and dew, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, omnis imber et ros, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πᾶς ὄμβρος καὶ δρόσος τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O all you spirits of God , bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, omnes spiritus Dei, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πάντα τὰ πνεύματα τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you fire and heat, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, ignis et æstus, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πῦρ καὶ καῦμα τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you cold and heat, bless the Lord , praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, frigus et æstus, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ψῦχος καὶ καύσων τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, rores et pruina, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε δρόσοι καὶ νιφετοί τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you frost and cold, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, gelu et frigus, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πάγος καὶ ψῦχος τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you ice and snow, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, glacies et nives, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πάχναι καὶ χιόνες τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you nights and days, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, noctes et dies, Domino laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε νύκτες καὶ ἡμέραι τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you light and darkness, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, lux et tenebræ, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε φῶς καὶ σκότος τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, fulgura et nubes, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ἀστραπαὶ καὶ νεφέλαι τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O let the earth bless the Lord : let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicat terra Dominum : laudet et superexaltet eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογείτω ἡ γῆ τὸν κύριον ὑμνείτω καὶ ὑπερυψούτω αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you mountains and hills, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, montes et colles, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε ὄρη καὶ βουνοί τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O all you things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, universa germinantia in terra, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
text_el: εὐλογεῖτε πάντα τὰ φυόμενα ἐν τῇ γῇ τὸν κύριον ὑμνεῖτε καὶ ὑπερυψοῦτε αὐτὸν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: O you fountains, bless the Lord : praise and exalt him above all for ever.
text_la: Benedicite, fontes, Domino : laudate et superexaltate eum in sæcula.
